import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pair {
        int a, b;
        Pair(int a, int b) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
        }
        public String toString() {
            return "{" + a + "," + b + "}";
        }
    }
    
    static class Modular {
        long v;
        static long mod;
        static long root; // not used here
        Modular(long vv) {
            v = vv % mod;
            if (v < 0) v += mod;
        }
        Modular s(long vv) {
            v = vv % mod;
            if (v < 0) v += mod;
            return this;
        }
        Modular plus(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular(v + rhs.v);
        }
        Modular minus(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular(v - rhs.v);
        }
        Modular times(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular((v * rhs.v) % mod);
        }
        Modular dividedBy(Modular rhs) {
            return this.times(rhs.inverse());
        }
        Modular pow(long n) {
            Modular res = new Modular(1);
            Modular x = new Modular(v);
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) res = res.times(x);
                x = x.times(x);
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
        Modular inverse() {
            return this.pow(mod - 2);
        }
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(v);
        }
        boolean equals(Modular rhs) {
            return v == rhs.v;
        }
    }

    static int topBit(int t) {
        if (t == 0) return -1;
        return 31 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(t);
    }

    static int topBit(long t) {
        if (t == 0) return -1;
        return 63 - Long.numberOfLeadingZeros(t);
    }

    static int botBit(int a) {
        if (a == 0) return 32;
        return Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(a);
    }

    static int botBit(long a) {
        if (a == 0) return 64;
        return Long.numberOfTrailingZeros(a);
    }

    static int popCount(int t) {
        return Integer.bitCount(t);
    }

    static int popCount(long t) {
        return Long.bitCount(t);
    }

    static boolean isPow2(int i) {
        return i != 0 && (i & -i) == i;
    }

    static long mask(int i) {
        return (1L << i) - 1;
    }

    static class FastReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch(IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        String nextLine() {
            try {
                return br.readLine();
            } catch(IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
        
        String readString() {
            return next();
        }
    }

    static final int MAXV = 10010;
    static Modular[] fact = new Modular[MAXV];
    static Modular[] finv = new Modular[MAXV];
    static Modular[] invs = new Modular[MAXV];

    static void initFact() {
        fact[0] = new Modular(1);
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXV; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1].times(new Modular(i));
        }
        finv[MAXV - 1] = fact[MAXV -1].inverse();
        for (int i = MAXV - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            finv[i] = finv[i+1].times(new Modular(i + 1));
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXV; i++) {
            invs[i] = finv[i].times(fact[i -1]);
        }
    }

    static Modular choose(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return new Modular(0);
        return fact[n].times(finv[n - k]).times(finv[k]);
    }

    static Modular binom(int a, int b) {
        return fact[a + b].times(finv[a]).times(finv[b]);
    }

    static Modular catalan(int n) {
        if (n <= 0) return new Modular(0);
        return binom(n, n).minus(n - 1 >= 0 ? binom(n - 1, n + 1) : new Modular(0));
    }

    static void solve() {
        FastReader fr = new FastReader();
        int n = fr.nextInt();
        int m = fr.nextInt();
        Modular.mod = fr.nextLong();

        initFact();

        Modular ans = new Modular(0);
        for (int len = 1; len < m; len++) {
            Modular f = new Modular(len + 1).pow(len).times(new Modular(len)).dividedBy(new Modular(n - len)).times(finv[len]);
            for (int i = 0; i <= m - len - 1; i++) {
                int j = i + len;
                Modular g = new Modular(n - len).pow(i).times(invs[i]);
                Modular h = new Modular(n - j).times(new Modular(n + 1)).pow(m - 1 - j).times(fact[j]);
                ans = ans.plus(f.times(g).times(h));
            }
        }
        ans = ans.times(new Modular(2).pow(m -1)).times(new Modular(n + 1 - m));
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
